description: Full-text search across a MusicBrainz entity type (artist, release-group, release, recording, work, label) using a Lucene query string. Returns ranked matches with MBID, name/title, disambiguation, type, and a 0–100 relevance score (100 = exact). Starting point when resolving a name to an MBID — chain the returned MBID into the matching musicbrainz_get_* tool. Results are in MusicBrainz score-descending order. Supports field-scoped Lucene syntax (e.g. `artist:radiohead AND country:GB`).

query.description: Lucene query string; must contain non-whitespace text. Plain text matches names/titles; field scoping (e.g. `artist:`, `country:`, `tag:`) is supported. Sent to MusicBrainz exactly as given.

name: musicbrainz_search_entities

effectiveQuery.description: The query string as sent to MusicBrainz.

entityType.description: The entity type that was searched.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blank_query`: The query contains only whitespace (it is blank after trimming). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when zero results matched — how to broaden or correct the query.

results.description: Ranked matches, in MusicBrainz score-descending order.

items.description: A ranked search hit. Type-specific fields appear only for the relevant entity type.

artistCredit.description: Credited artist string, for release-group/release/recording results. Omitted for artist/label/work.

country.description: Country code, for release/artist/label results. Omitted when absent.

date.description: First-release date (release-group) or release date (release). Omitted when absent.

disambiguation.description: Short qualifier distinguishing same-named entities. Omitted when absent.

isrcs.description: ISRCs on a recording result. Omitted when none.

iswcs.description: ISWCs on a work result. Omitted when none.

length.description: Recording length as m:ss. Omitted when unknown.

mbid.description: MusicBrainz identifier (UUID) — chain into the matching musicbrainz_get_* tool.

score.description: Lucene relevance score, 0–100. 100 = exact match; low scores are weak partial matches.

type.description: Entity subtype (artist type, release-group primary type, work type, label type). Omitted when absent.

totalCount.description: Total matches upstream before the limit/offset window.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: search entities
